guitar.notes: Funk/R&B band with guitar as part of horn-driven groove section; no single iconic model widely documented.

tone.target: bright clean funk lead with wah and light chorus/phaser sheen
tone.profile: bright clean funk lead with wah and light chorus/phaser sheen
tone.summary: A classic funk setup utilizing compression for punch, a light OD boost for crunch, the V-Wah for rhythmic sweeps, and Chorus/Room effects to add sheen over a Fender Twin style clean platform.
corrections: use clean amp with slight edge

blocks.purpose: The signature rhythmic wah sweep for funk lead lines.

Provide a bright and articulate cabinet sound matching the clean tone.
